entry.name: level
entry.label: Tuning level: gentle, deep or deepest

entry.name: maxPct
entry.label: CPU ceiling percent used by the deep level

entry.name: fansMode
entry.label: Fans while Max is on: auto, max or boost (empty: the legacy fansMax decides)

entry.name: middleClick
entry.label: What middle click toggles: last, max or eco

entry.name: lastMode
entry.label: Last non-normal mode chosen (eco or max), used by middle click

entry.name: showWatts
entry.label: Show CPU package watts in the panel (starts the root sampler)

entry.name: wattsGpu
entry.label: Add the dGPU's watts to the panel while something keeps it busy

entry.name: followProfile
entry.label: Follow the KDE power profile: power-saver = Eco, balanced = Normal, performance = Max

entry.name: syncProfile
entry.label: With followProfile: a mode picked in the widget also sets the KDE power profile (two-way)

entry.name: gpuBoost
entry.label: Run NVIDIA Dynamic Boost (nvidia-powerd) while Max is on
